newsitem.title: UK: Royal & Sun Alliance buys Canadian business.
newsitem.headline: Royal & Sun Alliance buys Canadian business.

text.p: Royal & Sun Alliance Insurance Group Plc said its life insurance unit in Canada had agreed to buy the individual life portfolio of Gerling Global Life Insurance, totalling C$60 million stg in gross premiums.
Royal Life Insurance Company (RLC) of Canada's distribution capability will "significantly expand and strengthen" as a result of the deal, Royal & Sun Alliance said.
The deal will also "materially increase" earnings of RLC from 1998 onwards, the company said.
"I expect this to benefit policyholders and shareholders alike," said David Barker, group director of worldwide life operations.
The amount paid was less than 0.5 percent of Royal & Sun Alliance's net assets at December 31, 1996, which totalled 6.341 billion stg.
